label: Особенно
description: A 10-sentence usage card for особенно (especially, particularly).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Singling out a favourite. 'Особенно' means especially, marking 'зима' as standing out among others. It precedes the element it foregrounds within the liking frame.
Strategic focus: Intensifying a state. 'Особенно' raises the predicative 'холодно' to mean unusually or particularly cold. Here it scales degree, not just selects a focus.
Strategic focus: Highlighting one of many. 'Особенно' introduces 'футбол' as the standout example after a general statement. It typically follows a comma to single out a member of a set.
Strategic focus: Scaling an adjective. 'Особенно' intensifies 'важно' to mean particularly important. It precedes the predicative to push it above the ordinary level.
Strategic focus: Foregrounding a group. 'Особенно' marks 'дети' as the ones most affected, especially glad. It precedes the predicate to highlight their heightened reaction.
Strategic focus: Intensifying an adjective in advice. 'Особенно' boosts 'осторожен' to mean especially careful. It strengthens the warning by raising the degree.
Strategic focus: Singling out a time. 'Особенно' highlights 'вечером' as the moment the beauty stands out most. It follows the main clause to add the standout circumstance.
Strategic focus: Intensifying a verb. 'Особенно' raises the degree of 'ценю', meaning especially value. It sits before the verb to strengthen the appreciation.
Strategic focus: Adjective above the norm. 'Особенно' lifts 'интересная' to mean particularly interesting, more than usual. It precedes the adjective it scales.
Strategic focus: With negation. In 'ничего особенно', the adverb pairs with negation to mean nothing in particular. It marks the lack of anything that stands out.
